agenda.title: Write the onboarding checklist
agenda.note:
What a new member reads on day one:

- **Install** the CLI and sign in
- Link a workspace with `sikstack link`
- Open the Agenda and pick the first item

agenda.title: Show the sync time in the header
Check the empty state copy
agenda.note:
The empty Agenda says nothing about where items come from.

> Add one here, or with `sikstack agenda-add`.

agenda.title: Pick a name for the export button
agenda.note:
Candidates:

1. Export
2. Download
3. Save a copy

*Export* reads best beside **Share**.

agenda.title: Draft the release note
agenda.note: Cover the new Agenda and the design folder.

agenda.title: Decide the retry policy for sync
agenda.note: Today a failed sync waits for the next run. Should it retry, and how often?
agenda.outcome: Three tries, a minute apart, then stop and say so

agenda.title: Try a darker sidebar
agenda.note: An old idea from the first round.
